## DEFAULT\_WITHDRAWAL\_TARGET\_UTILIZATION variable

The default maximum utilization a source market may reach when withdrawing shared liquidity, scaled by WAD.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DEFAULT_WITHDRAWAL_TARGET_UTILIZATION = 900000000000000000n
```
